usage: check_milestone.py [-h] [--id ID] [--project PROJECT] [--dir DIR]
                          [--milestone MILESTONE] [--uncheck] [--notes NOTES]
                          [--list] [--auto-complete]

Track granular milestone progress in plan files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id ID               Target Plan ID (default: the project's latest active
                        plan)
  --project PROJECT     Project name (default: from the repository)
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current)
  --milestone MILESTONE
                        Milestone name to mark as completed
  --uncheck             Revert milestone to pending
  --notes NOTES         Notes or rationale for milestone update
  --list                List milestones and progress without modifying
  --auto-complete       Automatically set plan status to completed if all
                        milestones are done
